cohort: The study included 85 pregnant women diagnosed with GDM based on IADPSG criteria, recruited from an antenatal clinic over a one-year period.
finding: The study found no statistically significant differences in birth weight, Apgar scores, neonatal hypoglycemia, or NICU admissions when comparing GDM and non-GDM pregnancies, suggesting that effective glycemic control can mitigate adverse outcomes despite a trend toward increased neonatal hypoglycemia in GDM cases.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was more common among the GDM participants (mean mode of delivery: 1.31).
